title: What's Left Unsaid? Detecting and Correcting Misleading Omissions in Multimodal News Previews

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures statistical prediction skew by evaluating class-wise precision and recall on the MM-MISLEADING benchmark, demonstrating that standard Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit a strong algorithmic bias toward predicting the 'non-misleading' class and systematically fail to detect omission-based misleading content.
